text: Found it: the Live button only lights up if the app believes your trading key is on GitHub, and it only checked a small marker file on the phone (lost after an update or reinstall) and never asked GitHub at app start. Fix: the app now asks GitHub whether the key secret exists, at start and whenever keys change, and enables Live from that. It ships in v0.114.30 (v0.114.29 is building now); I'll send the link.
